title: Private Release: Backup Gate Checklist (pre-upgrade)
content:
Purpose
- This checklist is the Release Engineering “backup gate” for Redwood Private upgrades.
- The upgrade may not begin until the backup gate is PASS (or an explicit exception is approved).

Applies to
- Redwood Private deployments (Kubernetes in VPC and on-prem, including partially/fully air-gapped).
- Any of:
  - Standard release train upgrades
  - Emergency hotfix upgrades (still requires a gate; see “Emergency path” section)
  - Helm chart changes that can modify persistence/state (DB migrations, schema changes, control plane config)

References / operator docs
- Policy (must read): backup-before-upgrade-policy (Confluence)
  - sources/confluence/eng-private-deployments/upgrade-and-rollback/backup-before-upgrade-policy.json
- Runbook: Backup create + verify (Confluence)
  - sources/confluence/eng-private-deployments/day-2-ops/runbook-private-backup-create-and-verify.json
- Overview: Backup/restore scope boundaries + terminology (Confluence)
  - sources/confluence/eng-private-deployments/day-2-ops/backup-restore-overview.json
- Observability spec: dashboards + alerts (Confluence)
  - sources/confluence/eng-platform/dashboards-and-alerts/private-backup-restore-observability.json
- Security key handling guidance (Confluence)
  - sources/confluence/security-and-compliance/risk-and-exceptions/private-backup-key-handling-guidance.json

How to use (Release Eng)
1) Copy this checklist into the release ticket / change request as an “Approval” section.
2) Fill in the “Release metadata” section.
3) Ensure backup is created AND verified within the allowed freshness window.
4) Attach evidence links (logs/artifacts/metrics) as listed.
5) Obtain sign-offs.

Section A — Release metadata (fill in)
- Customer / Environment name: ______________________________
- Cluster ID / Identifier (as used in dashboards): ______________________________
- Deployment mode: [ ] VPC (customer cloud)  [ ] On-prem  [ ] Air-gapped
- Region / Site (if applicable): ______________________________
- Current Redwood Private version: ______________________________
- Target Redwood Private version: ______________________________
- Upgrade window start/end (customer-approved): ______________________________
- Change request / ticket ID (Jira/ServiceNow/etc.): ______________________________
- Release Eng on point: ______________________________
- SRE on point (if engaged): ______________________________
- Solutions/PS on point (if customer-facing): ______________________________

Section B — Backup gate criteria (PASS/FAIL)

B1. Backup scope confirmed (PASS/FAIL)
- [ ] Confirm what state is covered for this deployment (control-plane DBs, artifacts, config/policy, certs/secrets where applicable) per “backup-restore-overview”.
- [ ] Confirm storage target used for backup (S3/GCS/Azure/NFS/minio/local bundle for air-gapped): ______________________________
- [ ] Confirm retention policy is enabled (or document why not): ______________________________
- [ ] Confirm no additional customer-specific state is needed (e.g., external SIEM export config, customer-managed integration secrets) OR it is documented as out of band.
Notes:
________________________________________________________________________________

B2. Preconditions satisfied (PASS/FAIL)
- [ ] Backup tooling installed/available in the environment (rw-private-dr present and version known).
  - rw-private-dr version: ______________________________
- [ ] Operator has correct permissions for storage target + KMS/HSM (least privilege). If using a break-glass role, record it.
  - Role/identity used: ______________________________
- [ ] Storage endpoint reachable from cluster/network (VPC endpoints / private routing / on-prem routes).
- [ ] Backup window does not overlap with known peak traffic or DB maintenance (if applicable).
Notes:
________________________________________________________________________________

B3. Backup created (PASS/FAIL)
- [ ] Backup create started at: ______________________________
- [ ] Backup create finished at: ______________________________
- [ ] Backup artifact ID / name / prefix: ______________________________
- [ ] Backup command used (paste exact):
  - rw-private-dr backup create …
  - (or CronJob run: namespace/name + run timestamp)
- [ ] Backup job status = Succeeded (Kubernetes Job/CronJob or CLI output confirms success).
Evidence to attach (links are acceptable):
- [ ] Job logs link / excerpt (sanitized): ______________________________
- [ ] Backup storage listing showing artifact presence (path/prefix): ______________________________
- [ ] Dashboard screenshot or metric showing “backup_success=1” and duration: ______________________________

B4. Backup verified (PASS/FAIL)
Verification must include integrity + decryptability + basic schema checks.
- [ ] Verification started at: ______________________________
- [ ] Verification finished at: ______________________________
- [ ] Verification command used (paste exact):
  - rw-private-dr backup verify …
- [ ] Checksums validated (or equivalent verification output is PASS).
- [ ] DB backup is readable (pg_restore/pg_dump validation step completed as required by runbook).
- [ ] For PITR-enabled environments: WAL archiving status checked and healthy (per runbook).
Evidence to attach:
- [ ] Verification output excerpt (sanitized): ______________________________
- [ ] If PITR: WAL archive check evidence (metric/log line): ______________________________

B5. Encryption + key handling confirmed (PASS/FAIL)
- [ ] Encryption at rest confirmed (SSE-KMS / customer-managed key / on-prem equivalent).
  - Key type: [ ] Customer KMS  [ ] HSM  [ ] Minio SSE  [ ] NFS at-rest controls  [ ] Local bundle encryption
- [ ] Redwood does not require plaintext access to customer keys (confirm setup aligns with key-handling guidance).
- [ ] Key/role rotation policy noted (if relevant for audits).
- [ ] Logs reviewed for secret leakage (spot check; must be redacted).
Evidence to attach:
- [ ] KMS key ID/alias (redacted as needed) or policy excerpt: ______________________________
- [ ] IAM policy / role name used (no secrets): ______________________________

B6. Backup freshness window met (PASS/FAIL)
- Define max age for this upgrade (default guidance; override only with customer approval):
  - Standard tier: backup must be <= 24h old at upgrade start
  - Strict tier: backup must be <= 4h old at upgrade start
- Tier selected for this customer: [ ] Standard  [ ] Strict  [ ] Custom (document)
- Backup timestamp: ______________________________
- Upgrade start timestamp (planned): ______________________________
- Freshness check result: [ ] PASS  [ ] FAIL
If FAIL: do not proceed; create a new backup or obtain exception approval.

B7. Restore readiness (pre-flight) completed (PASS/FAIL)
(Not a full restore drill; this is “we could restore if needed”.)
- [ ] Restore plan generated (rw-private-dr restore plan …) and reviewed.
- [ ] Confirm restore inputs exist (artifact paths, credentials, DB endpoints).
- [ ] Confirm maintenance mode procedure understood (who/when toggles during restore).
- [ ] Confirm rollback path: if upgrade fails, restore approach is agreed (in-place vs new cluster).
Evidence to attach:
- [ ] Restore plan output (sanitized) or file location: ______________________________
- [ ] Named runbook to be used in incident: ______________________________

Section C — Exception path (only if required)
Use only with explicit approvals; document why backup gate cannot be met.
- Exception reason (check one):
  - [ ] Storage outage / permissions blocked
  - [ ] Customer denied required access / cannot schedule backup window
  - [ ] Emergency security fix required immediately
  - [ ] Other: ______________________________
- Risk acceptance summary (2–5 sentences):
________________________________________________________________________________
- Mitigations (what we will do instead):
  - [ ] Snapshot alternative (cloud provider volume snapshot) — describe: ______________________________
  - [ ] Reduce blast radius (canary nodes / partial rollout) — describe: ______________________________
  - [ ] Extended on-call coverage (SRE + Eng Private) — names/time: ______________________________
- Approval required (names + timestamps):
  - Release Eng lead: ______________________________  Date/Time: ______________________________
  - SRE lead or sponsor (Rafael Mendes / Sean Gallagher): ______________________________  Date/Time: ______________________________
  - Security (if encryption/key risk involved; Marcus Lin or delegate): ______________________________  Date/Time: ______________________________
  - Customer approver (if applicable): ______________________________  Date/Time: ______________________________

Section D — Final sign-off (required to start upgrade)
Gate status (circle one): PASS / FAIL / EXCEPTION APPROVED
- Release Engineering sign-off
  - Name: ______________________________
  - Date/Time: ______________________________
  - Notes:
________________________________________________________________________________
- SRE sign-off (required for Strict tier customers and any customer-requested DR evidence)
  - Name: ______________________________
  - Date/Time: ______________________________
  - Notes:
________________________________________________________________________________
- Solutions/PS sign-off (required when SE/PS is running the customer change window)
  - Name: ______________________________
  - Date/Time: ______________________________

Section E — Post-upgrade (recommended, not a hard gate)
- [ ] Confirm backup schedule remains enabled and next run time is correct.
- [ ] Confirm backup dashboards show normal success rate and durations post-upgrade.
- [ ] If upgrade included DB migrations: confirm DB backup + PITR status healthy after upgrade.
- [ ] If customer requires evidence: attach post-upgrade verification screenshots/logs to the change request.

Quick links (copy/paste into incident channel if needed)
- Confluence runbook (backup create/verify): sources/confluence/eng-private-deployments/day-2-ops/runbook-private-backup-create-and-verify.json
- Confluence policy (backup before upgrade): sources/confluence/eng-private-deployments/upgrade-and-rollback/backup-before-upgrade-policy.json
- Observability: private backup/restore dashboards + alerts: sources/confluence/eng-platform/dashboards-and-alerts/private-backup-restore-observability.json
- Incident-bot shortcuts (if enabled in the workspace): /backup-status  and  /restore-checklist

Change log
- 2025-10-03: Initial version (release train Q4). Owner: Connor O’Brien.
- 2025-11-19: Added encryption/key-handling evidence requirements (Security review feedback).
- 2025-12-11: Added freshness tiering (Standard vs Strict) + exception approvals.
- 2026-01-21: Updated restore readiness section to reference restore plan + maintenance mode assumptions.
